{
  "sql": "SELECT
  act.molregno AS molecule_chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  cr.compound_key,
  COALESCE(act.pubmed_id, act.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi,
  a.description AS assay_description,
  act.standard_type,
  act.standard_relation,
  act.standard_value,
  act.standard_units,
  act.activity_comment,
  td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id,
  td.pref_name AS target_name,
  td.organism AS target_organism
FROM activities act
JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON a.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON act.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_records cr ON md.molregno = cr.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1914'
  AND act.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND act.standard_relation = '='
  AND act.standard_units = 'nM'
  AND (act.pubmed_id IS NOT NULL OR act.doi IS NOT NULL);"
}
